text:
**Brief: Willow work plan (upload, billing, webhooks, quota, ledger, pricing)**

Produce a work plan covering these six components. Hard constraints:

- webhooks: max_workers = 14. Only worker alpha may run webhooks.
- pricing: timeout_s = 35. Worker alpha owns pricing.
- billing: retry_limit = 5.
- ledger: timeout_s = 95.
- Derived: ledger.timeout_s > 85 means quota.retry_limit ≤ 2. billing.retry_limit > 3 means quota.batch_size ≤ 200.
- billing and upload run on different workers.
- quota and upload run on the same worker.
- Execution order: pricing before ledger.
- upload depends on pricing.
- No dependency path from quota to pricing, direct or transitive. Quota must not depend on upload either, since upload depends on pricing.
- types.py and tokens.py belong to upload.
- Code review turnaround under one day.

Team judgment: upload ttl_s and database choices. Ignore legacy values and meeting notes.
